# mailtrap_project (Resource)

Manages a Mailtrap project that groups sandboxes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mailtrap_project" "example" {
  name = "My Project"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the project.
- `share_links` (Attributes) Public share URLs for the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--share_links))

<a id="nestedatt--share_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `share_links`

Read-Only:

- `admin` (String)
- `viewer` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a project by its numeric ID.
terraform import mailtrap_project.example 12345
```
